messages:
Ava: Quick design sync  thinking about regrouping the left rail into tiles (Build | Serve | Observe) rather than long nested lists. Attached tiny mock. Main asks: permalink stability, breadcrumb verbosity, accessibility announcements.

Sam: Interesting. My first thought is permalinks. We must ensure `/console/models/:id` stays canonical. UI grouping should map to query state, not change resource paths.

Rohit: Agreed. Proposal: routing layer that keeps canonical paths and sets `?tile=serve` for UI cluster. For deep anchors allow `#panel=latency`. Use `history.replaceState` when mapping hashes to avoid cluttering back nav.

Elaine: Accessibility: when users switch tiles, screen readers need an announcement like "Tile: Serve, 4 items" and focus should move into the tile container. Add `aria-current="true"` to the active item and `aria-expanded` to collapsible groups.

NavBot: /audit left-rail -> Found: missing `aria-expanded` on 2 group toggles; no live region for tile change. Recommend `role=region` + `aria-live=polite` on tile content.

Ava: Breadcrumbs: current is "Console > Models > 77". Suggest richer form: "Console \u203a Models \u203a ImageGen v1.2" but clamp to 42 chars and show full title in tooltip or long-press on mobile.

Sam: For analytics, prefer emitting a normalized path in events (e.g., `/console/models/:id/tile/serve`) so dashboards don't explode with query variants. Also preserve utm params through redirects.

Rohit: Implementation note (pseudo):
```
const hash = location.hash;
if (hash.startsWith('#panel=')) {
  const panel = new URLSearchParams(hash.slice(1)).get('panel');
  router.replace({ pathname: location.pathname, query: { ...router.query, panel } }, undefined, { shallow: true });
  focusPanel(panel);
}
```
Use `replace` to avoid pushState spam. Add tests for back-button behavior.

Elaine: When focusing a panel from hash navigation call `announceForAccessibility(panelLabel)` and ensure the live region clears after a short timeout to avoid repeated reads. Add `aria-labelledby` on panels.

Ava: Action items: 1) routing shim + analytics mapping (Sam), 2) ARIA + announcement helpers + axe run (Elaine), 3) breadcrumb copy rules + mobile clamp (Rohit). Sync Friday 10am.

Sam: I'll prototype the routing adaptor, include redirects for older doc links, and tests for preserving utm. ETA Wed.

Rohit: I'll write the breadcrumb spec (max 42 chars, middle truncation, tooltip = full slug) and add mobile examples.

Elaine: I'll add aria attrs, `role=region`, `aria-live=polite` and run `axe-core`. Will paste results here and include a small keyboard E2E to validate focus order.

Ava: Thanks! Tiny Loom with the mock: https://loom.com/share/unique-mock-01 (2m). NavBot: please ping before sync. :calendar:
